title: Prediction of miscibility in chlorinated polyethylene/poly(vinyl chloride) blends via atomistic molecular dynamics simulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,916-930
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09560C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhihao Ma, Xue Li, Huaguo Xu, Jianxiang Shen, Jun Liu
Atomistic MD simulations quantitatively predict the miscibility of chlorinated polyethylene (CPE)/PVC blends, revealing that random-CPE architecture exhibits higher compatibility with PVC than block-CPE, exhibiting LCST-type phase behaviour.
